setting.activity: Managing traffic flow and assisting lost individuals

agent.name: Sarah
agent.style: Authoritative but polite, speaks clearly over noise

dialog.input_text: Excuse me, officer! I'm trying to find the loading dock for the main commercial building. They blocked off the usual street.
dialog.agent_text: Yes, that road is temporarily closed for utility work. You will need to take the next available right turn, then circle around the block to access the rear alleyway.

dialog.input_text: Right turn, then circle the block. Got it. Is the alley entrance clearly marked?
dialog.agent_text: It has standard delivery signage, but the entrance is quite narrow. Just watch out for pedestrians crossing the mouth of the alley.

dialog.input_text: Pardon me, could I get some help crossing? These bags are terribly heavy and the cars keep turning on the walk signal.
dialog.agent_text: Certainly. I can assist you across safely. Please stand behind the white line until I halt the turning traffic.

dialog.input_text: Hey, do you want me to put one of those bags on my cart? I'm heading in the same general direction.
Oh, that would be wonderful. My arms are completely numb.
Officer, if we're crossing together, should we wait for your signal now?
dialog.agent_text: Yes, please wait right there. Once the light changes, I will step out and blow my whistle to ensure the intersection is clear for both of you.

dialog.input_text: Thank you so much. Traffic is completely overwhelming today.
dialog.agent_text: It is definitely congested right now. Just keep an eye on my hand signals and we will get you across.
